name: context-governor
description: Warn-only context watch: a checkpoint note at 120k context, a /fast-compact or handoff note at 200k, and a note when many turns pass without a new artifact. Never blocks, compacts or ends a turn.

softTokens.title: Checkpoint threshold
softTokens.description: Context tokens for the soft checkpoint note.

strongTokens.title: Compact threshold
strongTokens.description: Context tokens for the strong compact/handoff note.

rearmGapTokens.title: Re-arm gap
rearmGapTokens.description: A threshold re-arms when context falls below threshold minus this gap.

staleTurns.title: Stale turns
staleTurns.description: Main-loop turns with no new artifact before the stale note.

artifactDir.title: Artifact folder
artifactDir.description: The active experiment folder. Empty turns the stale rule off. CONTEXT_GOVERNOR_ARTIFACT_DIR overrides it.

subagentFlagTokens.title: Subagent flag tokens
subagentFlagTokens.description: Marks subagent turns in metrics only. Never produces a note.

softText.title: Checkpoint note text
softText.default: checkpoint: context {k}, consider writing state to the experiment folder

strongText.title: Compact note text
strongText.description: Placeholders: {k} context and {limit} threshold, both in thousands.
strongText.default: context {k} ≥ {limit}k: run `/fast-compact` then `/compact`, or hand off with `make_capsule.mjs` to a fresh phase session

staleText.title: Stale note text
staleText.description: Placeholder: {turns} turns without a new artifact.
staleText.default: {turns} turns without a new artifact: logs piling up?
